newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Sage sees yr shr up by around 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sage sees yr shr up by around 25 pct.

text.p: South African life assurance group Sage Group Ltd said on Tuesday it expected earnings growth for the full year to be of the same order as that achieved in the first half.
Sage reported headline earnings up 25.2 percent to 51.7 cents a share. It declared a dividend of 31.0 cents up from 25.0 cents before.

"The group is confident about prospects for the full year and anticipates that the rate of growth in earnings per share will be of the same order as in the first half of the year," it said in a statement.
